<thought>To calculate DBE for C13H13O4, use the standard formula DBE = (2C + 2 - H)/2 (ignoring O). Plugging in C=13, H=13 gives DBE = (26 + 2 - 13)/2 = 15/2 = 7.5. Since the task requests an integer, we round to the nearest whole number, yielding 8.</thought>
<final_answer>8</final_answer>
